newsitem.title: FRANCE: Algerian forces kill six militants - paper.
newsitem.headline: Algerian forces kill six militants - paper.

text.p: Algerian security forces have killed six Moslem guerrillas holed up in a farm in the southwestern province of Saida, 350 km (220 miles) from Algiers, an Algerian newspaper said on Sunday.

The slaying of the six, who included a local guerrilla leader, on Thursday brought to more than 30 the number of Moslem rebels shot dead by security forces in the province in the past four months, said El Watan newspaper.
Southern provinces have been spared most of the violence which has shaken Algeria for nearly five years.

Algerian security forces killed 5,029 Moslem guerrillas in 1994 and 1995, according to an official report released last June by the officially-appointed human rights watchdog, the National Observatory of Human Rights (ONDH).

An estimated 50,000 people have died in the violence pitting Moslem guerrillas against government forces since early 1992 when the authorities cancelled a general election in which radical Islamists had taken a commanding lead.
